name: Pascale Muylaert
title: Senior corporate executive and leadership coach
bio_short: Senior corporate executive and leadership coach with more than 25 years' experience in 46 countries. Former senior roles at Novartis, Unilever, Danone, Vodafone and BA. UN Representative at Soroptimist International. London-based. Trilingual.
bio: Pascale is a senior corporate executive, coach and strategist with more than 25 years' experience. She has worked in 46 countries, managing large teams and implementing programmes for major organisations including Novartis, SABMiller, Unilever, Lego, Danone, British Airways, Vodafone, McDonald's, GlaxoSmithKline, Bayer and Mars. Her career has spanned corporate strategy, brand management, organisational development and communications. She has also worked with OxfordSM, a management consultancy, and Electrocomponents, a global industrial distributor.  Pascale currently serves as UN Representative at Soroptimist International, bringing an international development and advocacy dimension to her professional profile. She holds a Master's degree in marketing from Vlerick Business School in Belgium.  At ISOC, Pascale delivers interpersonal skills, corporate communications and leadership programmes. Her combination of strategic and operational experience makes her particularly effective with participants who hold or aspire to senior roles. She helps professionals develop the communication, stakeholder management and personal effectiveness skills they need to operate at a leadership level in complex international organisations. Her trilingual capability in English, French and Dutch and her experience across 46 countries make her well suited to multilingual European and international training environments. Pascale is based in London.
